story: In the diverse world of birds, the Oriental Dollarbird (Eurystomus orientalis) stands out. This species, part of the Coraciidae family, is a resident of Open woodland; forest edges; parks; gardens; mangroves; and riverine habitats. Its IUCN Red List status is Least Concern (LC), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Oriental Dollarbird is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Oriental Dollarbird and its role in the ecosystem.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
